meta.name: start-work
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says start work, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行计划,由多个智能体分工推进并持续记录进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果已经排好一份计划,想交给 AI 智能体按步骤执行并保持进度同步
copy.tagline_en: Run your plan with parallel agents and keep progress tracked.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a ready plan and want AI agents to execute it while keeping progress tracked.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成执行计划的“编排者”：把计划拆成小任务，全部交给子代理并行完成；自己只负责选计划、更新状态、验收结果，绝不亲手写代码或改产品文件。
howto.when: 在计划制定完成后，当你说“start work”“execute plan”“continue plan”等，或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的某个计划时触发。

say.note: 触发执行当前已选定的 Prometheus 计划。

say.text: 执行 .omo/plans 里的 myplan 计划
继续执行之前暂停的计划
say.note: 恢复该会话未完成的计划。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an orchestrator: it breaks the plan into small tasks, delegates all implementation to parallel subagents, and only handles plan selection, state updates, and verification — never writing code or editing product files itself.
howto.when_en: Triggered after planning when you say 'start work', 'execute plan', 'continue plan', etc., or ask to run a .omo/plans plan.

say_en.note: Starts executing the currently selected Prometheus plan.
Resumes unfinished plan work for this session.
